title: Plunzi's Midnight GUI
description: Let your lovely eyes take a rest from too bright LEDs.
body:
# Plunzi's Midnight GUI

Give your eyes a break from too bright LEDs and relax a little with my dark-themed Minecraft GUI resource pack. It’s less bright and themed modern, making it easier on the eyes and a bit more stylish too!

## Resource pack preview:

### Survival Hotbar

This resource pack improves the vanilla hotbar by increasing its clarity, contrast, and clearly separating different HUD elements. Whilst getting rid of the overwhelmingly bright white LEDs.

![Survival Hotbar Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0552e9e15d8493c9c2fb0b869c30a20049440019.png)

### Survival Inventory

The inventory was mainly decluttered and reduced to the very essentials. A good UI should not fight for your attention and should be immediately clear. Actions are now indicated with colors. An example would be the red trash button in the creative inventory.

![Inventory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/54e8bcd1d6bbda81c0f5a2114686ced259f49bac.png)

![Creative Inventory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d29361ec82bd665d6b977e5cfbdaf33bdd728360.png)

### Advancements

All advancement types now have their own distinctive look, making it easier to distinguish easy, medium, and hard achievements from each other. The background was also adjusted to be less draining on the eyes while preserving the biome's block textures.

![Advancements](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cad7698ced85602b664b6b454a5a60f95e7c1100.png)

### Options

All generic UI components are now dark themed and slightly improved. One nice addition are arrows on the left and right of sliders.

![Options](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/498a5ebc81815d485b35d1cbabce0b56c412bf61_0.webp)
